t: On October 5, 1939, John V. Campbell executed an option offering to sell certain land to the City and County of San Francisco, a municipal corporation, for the sum of $23,750.00, required for the widening of Portola Drive from Sydney to Waitham Way…
pl: John Campbell sells land for $23,750 to widen Portola Drive

t: Denying Blasting Permit, J. P. Holland, East Side Ulloa Street, South of Waltham Place.
pl: J. P. Holland refused permission to blast on Ulloa Street
